kebab_example: aliyun ecd create-nas-file-system --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --office-site-id cn-hangzhou+dir-3633530000 --name testNAS --description testDescription --storage-type Capacity --encrypt-type 0 --protocol-type example-string --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateNASFileSystem

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~) to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The NAS file system name. The name must meet the following requirements: The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters and Chinese characters. The name must start with a letter or a Chinese character and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. The name can contain digits, underscores (_), or hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: NAS文件系统名称。文件名称需遵循以下规则：长度为2\~128个英文或中文字符。必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。可以包含数字、下划线（_）或短划线（-）
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The description of the NAS file system
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The storage type of the NAS file system
parameters.help_zh: NAS文件系统的存储规格类型
parameters.name: storage_type

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the file system uses a KMS-managed key to encrypt data stored on the file system. Encrypted data does not need to be decrypted during read and write operations
parameters.help_zh: 文件系统是否使用KMS服务托管密钥，对文件系统落盘数据进行加密存储。在读写加密数据时，无需解密
